en: A black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing American soldiers marching in formation through a large Parisian square, rifles on their shoulders and a U.S. flag at the front. In the background stands a monumental statue on a pedestal, surrounded by a grand neoclassical building with columns and arched ground floor, likely the Place de la Concorde area. The postcard includes bilingual French and English captions beneath the image, identifying the scene as an American troops parade before the Statue of Strasbourg in Paris on July 4th, 1918.
